system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"Your API endpoints (eg /me, /browse/featured-playlists) are frequently returning a 404 errors (eg 50% of all requests). Is something going on at HQ?"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"<USER> Hey! If you think this could be useful, suggest it in our Community at <URL> and get support from other users"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Reply doesn't address the reported API issue or provide helpful information."}
